insights.text: Malaysia Women win 63% of our simulations.
The toss matters: Malaysia Women win 66% batting first v 60% chasing.
Powerplay: Malaysia Women ~25 runs for 1.5 wickets; no wicket at all in 20% of simulations.
Malaysia Women's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; Zhao Yihan is the likeliest to take it (17%).
Ainna Hamizah Hashim is Malaysia Women's likeliest top scorer (28%), with a 20% chance of 30+.
Powerplay: China Women ~26 runs for 2.1 wickets; no wicket at all in 11% of simulations.
China Women's first wicket most likely falls around over 3; Nur Dania Syuhada is the likeliest to take it (19%).
Cai Yuzhi is China Women's likeliest top scorer (18%), with a 10% chance of 30+.
Nurin Imanina leads Malaysia Women's attack: 36% chance of 2+ wickets.
Zhao Yihan leads China Women's attack: 27% chance of 2+ wickets.
Key duel: Nurin Imanina dismisses Lyu Yihan in 18% of simulations.
